title: DevOfPie/Mustur
body: Mustur's own checkout. The only repository in this registry: a routing row for a repository that has not been onboarded would be a claim about a tree nothing here verifies, and onboarding is a milestone with its own verdict.

title: whippy-vm
body: The machine holding the checkout and, later, the adapter that supervises sessions. Reached over the home network; not itself a Mustur session host yet.

title: Mustur
body: The project this store belongs to. Its identifier prefix is MUS, and every record here carries it.
